description: Source code for a soundfile-based audio mixer class that loads, manages, and mixes audio files with live audio streams, supporting runtime configuration changes and looping.

classes.name: SoundfileMixer
classes.description: An audio mixer class that combines incoming audio with sound files loaded via the soundfile library, supporting multiple formats, runtime updates, and looping.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SoundfileMixer with sound files, default sound, volume, and looping options.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Loads all sound files asynchronously based on the provided sample rate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup; currently does nothing.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes control frames to update settings or enable/disable mixing.

methods.name: mix
methods.description: Mixes incoming audio bytes with the current sound file.

methods.name: _update_settings
methods.description: Updates mixer settings such as sound, volume, and loop based on control frames.

methods.name: _change_sound
methods.description: Switches the current sound file to a specified one.

methods.name: _update_volume
methods.description: Updates the volume level for mixing.

methods.name: _load_sound_file
methods.description: Loads an audio file into memory for later mixing.

methods.name: _mix_with_sound
methods.description: Performs the actual mixing of raw audio with the loaded sound file chunk.
